input:
After enabling Smart ROI (SROI) on our 50MP sensor over MIPI CSI-2 v4.0, the ISP output shows partial frames — the bottom ~20% of the cropped region is missing or contains garbage data. The sensor is configured for 4:3 SROI crop from full 8192x6144 down to a 4096x3072 ROI window.

dmesg:
  [  12.341] csi2_rx: SROI metadata received, crop_x=2048 crop_y=1536 w=4096 h=3072
  [  12.341] csi2_rx: frame_start vc=0 dt=0x2b (RAW10)
  [  12.345] isp_fe: input resolution mismatch: expected 4096x3072, got 4096x2448
  [  12.345] isp_fe: line_count=2448, missing 624 lines (20.3%)
  [  12.346] isp_fe: SROI crop_y=1536 not aligned to 16-line boundary
  [  12.346] csi2_rx: short_packet: frame_end received early at line 2448

V4L2 subdev query:
  $ v4l2-ctl --get-crop -d /dev/v4l-subdev3
  Crop: Left 2048, Top 1536, Width 4096, Height 3072

The sensor datasheet says SROI crop origin must be 8-pixel aligned, but the ISP requires 16-line alignment. What is causing the partial frame and how do we fix the SROI crop parameters?
